entities.summary: Francesca Jones is a British professional tennis player. She has a career-high singles ranking of No. 69 by the WTA achieved on 12 January 2026. Jones has won two WTA 125 titles and eight titles on the ITF circuit, breaking into the top 100 after winning 2025 Palermo Ladies Open in Italy. She had a career-high ITF juniors ranking of world No. 31, achieved on 1 May 2017.
